# Vendr

> Vendr is an AI-powered SaaS procurement platform providing pricing transparency, negotiation automation, and cost savings across $15B+ of contract-verified software pricing data.

Vendr empowers procurement teams and businesses to make data-driven software purchasing decisions through its Ruth AI agent, OpenPrice and Negotiation APIs, Chrome extension, and comprehensive marketplace of 250+ SaaS suppliers. The Y Combinator-backed company has secured $216M+ in funding and serves enterprise customers including Mural, Root Inc., Enverus, and Docebo.
